evidence_scope: Steady workload at target concurrency 6 only; pooled from Phase 7D and Phase 7E. This is a deployment-specific benchmark summary, not a universal runtime performance claim.

steady_concurrency_6_pooled.interpretation: Serverless had about 9.83% higher mean wave throughput and a lower request-level P95, but also about 9.80% higher mean server latency, higher median latency, and a 13.54 percentage-point higher SLO violation rate. Container is therefore the default for balanced and latency/SLO objectives. Serverless is offered only as an explicit throughput-priority option with explicit SLO-risk acknowledgement.
